title: First User Action
scenario: Find the 'user_id' of the user who performed their first 'confirmed' action earliest across all users. Return the result table as 'user_id'.
tableSchema: signups (user_id INT, time_stamp DATETIME), confirmations (user_id INT, time_stamp DATETIME, action VARCHAR)
hint: Filter for 'confirmed' actions, group by user_id to find their first time, then order by that time.
correctQuery: SELECT user_id FROM confirmations WHERE action = 'confirmed' ORDER BY time_stamp ASC LIMIT 1;
setupSQL: CREATE TABLE confirmations (user_id INT, time_stamp DATETIME, action VARCHAR); INSERT INTO confirmations VALUES (2, '2021-01-22 00:00:00', 'confirmed'), (7, '2021-06-12 11:57:29', 'confirmed');
